envelope.description: Move the issue wrappers, ghCreateLabel and ghCurrentLogin onto runGh and narrow the typed-create retry

body.title: Move the issue wrappers, ghCreateLabel and ghCurrentLogin onto runGh and narrow the typed-create retry
body.summary: Switch ghCreateIssueTyped, ghLinkSubIssue, ghGetIssueBody, ghEditIssueBody, ghComment, ghCloseIssue, ghEnsureMilestone, ghAttachMilestone, ghCreateLabel and ghCurrentLogin to runGh while keeping each wrapper's signature (labels stay readonly string[]) and its current failure result (throw, boolean or swallow). The typed create retries untyped only on a confirmed issue-type rejection. queryTasks, ghGetIssueState and the other setup functions stay as they are.
acceptanceChecks: Each migrated wrapper runs the same gh argv as before and keeps its failure result
A typed create that fails with a timeout, missing tool, missing sign-in or a non-type rejection is not followed by a second POST
A typed create rejected as an unknown issue type is retried once untyped and reports typed false
ghCurrentLogin still throws the 'returned no login' Error for empty output
Existing tests that pinned the catch-everything retry are updated to the new policy
